sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The fixture has unconditional shutdownNow and requires termination within five seconds in finally. ExecutorService.close would wait indefinitely.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: JUnit workers and joins only, no J2EE service. Each independent audit has its own closed JSON output, with explicit bounds and ownership.
